topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for the hallmarks of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by introducing the learning outcomes and providing an overview of the hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Sustained proliferative and growth signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the intracellular pathways and genetic mutations that drive sustained proliferative signaling and growth independence in cancer.

topics.label: Differentiation block in hematopoietic and epithelial malignancies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells impair terminal differentiation to sustain proliferative progenitor states across different tissue lineages.

topics.label: Evasion of programmed cell death and apoptosis resistance
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic focuses on the apoptotic pathway and the molecular mechanisms tumors use to prevent programmed cell death.

topics.label: Telomere dynamics, cellular senescence, and replicative immortality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the limit on cell division imposed by telomere shortening and how tumors overcome senescence through telomerase reactivation.

topics.label: p53 stress integration and summary of cell-autonomous hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how p53 coordinates cellular responses to genomic stress and summarize the cell-autonomous growth hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate cancer metabolic alterations including aerobic glycolysis, global metabolic rewiring, and the oncogenic impact of Krebs cycle mutations.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic covers the angiogenic switch and how expanding tumors stimulate new blood vessel formation to ensure nutrient supply.

topics.label: Mechanisms, monitoring, and genomics of cancer metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the multistep process of cancer metastasis, including circulation dynamics, seeding efficiency, and secondary tumor genomics.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and summary
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides final summary thoughts on the cancer hallmarks framework and concludes the lecture.
